$comment: PS-360. Route files that MUST stay protected by requireCronSecret but are not discoverable from their path (no `cron` segment). The gate discovers them via their guard import; this manifest is the backstop so that deleting BOTH the import and the call -- which would silently remove the file from the import-based population -- fails as 'expected protected handler missing guard' instead of passing vacuously. Add a file here whenever a non-cron machine route adopts the cron secret.
